sights.n: Taushubetsu River Bridge (タウシュベツ川橋梁)
sights.address: Nukabira, Kamishihoro, Katō District, Hokkaido 080-1403, Japan
sights.w: The 1937 concrete arch viaduct of the abandoned Shihoro Line in Lake Nukabira — the 'phantom bridge' that surfaces and sinks with the reservoir; Japan Heritage.

sights.address: Shikaribetsu-kohan, Shikaoi, Katō District, Hokkaido 081-0300, Japan
sights.w: Hokkaido's highest lake (810 m) and the only natural lake in Daisetsuzan National Park — canoeing in summer, an ice village with lake-ice onsen in winter.

sights.n: Kōfuku Station (旧国鉄広尾線 幸福駅)
sights.w: The closed Hiroo Line halt whose name means 'happiness' — the 'Ai-koku → Kōfuku' (from Love Country to Happiness) ticket made it a pilgrimage; old railcars and ticket-covered walls remain.

sights.n: Rokkatei Art Village Nakasatsunai (六花亭 中札内美術村)
sights.address: Sakae-Higashi 3, Nakasatsunai, Kasai District, Hokkaido 089-1330, Japan
sights.w: Rokkatei's oak-forest art village — four small museums, the sweets maker's restaurant and paths on old railway sleepers; free, late April–early November.
Japan's first conifer garden — 83,000 m² of Japanese, Western and landscape gardens with thousands of trees from Northern Europe and Canada; on the Hokkaido Garden Path.

sights.n: Tokachi Millennium Forest (十勝千年の森)
sights.address: Haobi, Shimizu, Kamikawa District (Tokachi), Hokkaido 089-0356, Japan
sights.w: A forest planned to last a thousand years, with Dan Pearson's Earth, Meadow, Forest and Farm gardens — horse trekking and Segway tours; Hokkaido Garden Path.

sights.address: Nishi 3-sen 107, Nakasatsunai, Kasai District, Hokkaido 089-1366, Japan
sights.w: Rokkatei's 100,000 m² meadow of the 'Tokachi six flowers' painted on its wrapping paper, with small galleries of botanical art; Hokkaido Garden Path.

sights.address: Kutchan / Makkari / Kyōgoku / Niseko, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: 'Ezo-Fuji' — a near-perfect 1,898 m stratovolcano towering over the Niseko ski fields; its snowmelt feeds the Fukidashi springs.

sights.address: 15 Kisen-kita, Nakafurano, Sorachi District, Hokkaido 071-0704, Japan
sights.w: The farm that kept Furano's lavender alive and made it famous — July's purple slopes and the striped 'Irodori' flower field under the Tokachi range. Free entry.
